why: Searches found only a 2024/2025 computational survey (arXiv 2412.11933) extending the search bound to z^r <= 2^100 confirming the same ten known solutions, and unrelated cyclotomic work by Mihailescu on a different variant equation; the finiteness question itself remains open with no proof, disproof, or new qualifying solution reported.

found.title: Generalised Fermat equation: a survey of solved cases
found.note: Survey/computation extending search bound for the Fermat-Catalan equation to z^r <= 2^100, confirming only the ten previously known solutions; a record extension, not an answer to the finiteness question.
